text.body:
mukhyena sampradāyitvaṃ sampradāyavidāṃ naye । sampradāyigurordīkṣāmantragrahaṇato bhaveta॥1॥
śiṣṭaparamparācāryopadiṣṭamantrā eva hi । sampradāya iti khyātaḥ sudhībhiḥ sampradāyibhiḥ ॥2॥
śiṣṭatvaṃ nāma cāmnāyaprāmāṇyābhyupagantṛtā । vedānāṃ viṣṇupāramyātśiṣṭo vaiṣṇava ucyate ॥3॥
atatparasparatvena vaiṣṇavatvaṃ na siddhyati । avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭenetyādi śāstraprakopaṇāta॥4॥
tasmātśiṣṭānuśiṣṭānāṃ paramparāṃ rirakṣiṣuḥ । svaniḥśvasitavedo'pi gauro mādhvamataṃ gataḥ ॥5॥
sarvajagadguruḥ śrīmadgaurāṅgo lokaśikṣayā । purīśvaraṃ guruṃ kṛtvā svīcakre sampradāyakam ॥6॥
kañcinmataviśeṣo'pi nirastastattvavādinām । śrīmadgaurāṅgadevena sampradāyasya tena kim ॥7॥
sampradāyaikadīkṣāṇāṃ mithaḥ kiñcinmatāntarāta। śākhābhedo bhavenmātraṃ sampradāyo na bhidyate ॥8॥
rāmānandī yathā rāmānujīyāntargato bhaveta। nimbārkasampradāye ca harivyāsādayo yathā ॥9॥
gauḍīyastattvavādī ca tathā mādhvamataṃ gatau । na hyatra bādhakaḥ kaścitdṛśyate tattvavittamaiḥ ॥10॥
tuṣyatviti matenāpi sampradāyaviniścaye । svīkṛtaṃ sādhakatvena cetsādhyādivivecanam । tathāpyatyantabhedo na śrīgauramādhvayormate ॥11॥
madhvamate ca yā muktiḥ sādhyatvena prakīrtitā । viṣṇvaṅghriprāptirūpā sā bhāṣyakṛdbhiḥ pradarśitā ॥12॥
sādhanaṃ cārpitaṃ karmajīvādhikārabhedataḥ । svīkṛtamapi madhvena bhakteḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ bahustutam ॥13॥
pramāṇaṃ bhārataṃ mātraṃ madhvamate'nṛtaṃ vacaḥ । yattena trividhaṃ proktaṃ mukhyaṃ śabdapramāṇakam ॥14॥
śrīmannartakagopālasevā yena pratiṣṭhitā । iṣṭatvena kathaṃ tasya nirṇīto dvārakāpatiḥ ॥15॥
niścito dvārkādhīśo yadyapi vā kṣatiḥ kutaḥ । yo nandanandanaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva dvārakāpatiḥ । svarūpayordvayo aikyaṃ kṛṣṇatvamaviśeṣaḥ ॥16॥
līlābhimānabhedena pūrṇatamaśca pūrṇakaḥ । na tu svarūpato bhedastayorasti kathañcana ॥17॥
bhedābhedamataṃ yaccācintyākhyaṃ kīrtyate budhaiḥ । śrīcaitanyamatābhijñaiḥ tacca madhvamateṅgitam ॥18॥
jīvānāṃ brahmavaijātye guṇāṃśatvādabhinnatā । pratiyogitvabhedatve cinmātratvāttadekatā ॥19॥
tadvyāpyatvatadāyattavṛttikatvādihetutaḥ । sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca gosvāmimadhvayoḥ samam ॥20॥
vicāramātranaipuṇyaṃ śaktiśaktimatoriha । gaurakṛpodbhavo'cintyavādo gosvāmibhiḥ smṛtaḥ । tattvanirdhāraṇe mukhyaḥ kāraṇavāda ucyate ॥21॥
parākhyaśaktimadbrahma nimittakāraṇaṃ bhaveta। upādānaṃ tu tadbrahma jīvapradhānaśaktiyuka। iti kāraṇavāde'pi hyubhayormatayoḥ samam ॥22॥
śrīgovindābhidhaṃ bhāṣyaṃ pramāṇaṃ yadi manyate । prameyaratnasiddhāntaniṣkṛṣṭā tatsamāhṛtiḥ ॥23॥
vakti śrīgaurasammatiṃ madhvaḥ prāhetyupakrame । yadi vopekṣate kaiścittarhyardhakukkuṭinayaḥ ॥24॥
iti śrīśrīgauḍīyavaiṣṇavasāhitye śrīharidāsadāsamahodayena dhṛtam ॥
